title: Define and Enforce source_of_truth Path-Resolution Semantics

preflight.note: Stamped by `repopact new`; the work item was recorded before implementation began.

acceptance_criteria.text: A formal, documented path-resolution rule for `source_of_truth:` frontmatter is written (a decisions/ record), stating explicitly that it is record-relative (resolved against the directory of the file declaring it), matching decision 0016's existing treatment and takeover.py's existing implementation -- the only documented and implemented precedent found during F-017's investigation (research/captures/016-forgewire-wi238-3-0-0-field-evidence.md).

A fixture reproduces ForgeWire's exact valid case from F-017: a record at a nested path declaring a `../`-prefixed source_of_truth pointer to a real sibling-directory file, and doctor's resolution correctly does not flag it.

doctor.py's `_dead_source_of_truth` is updated to resolve every token according to the documented rule from AC-1, and the existing `test_doctor_flags_dead_source_of_truth_pointer` fixture (a bare, `/`-free token from decisions/9999-probe.md) is re-examined: if the documented rule changes its expected outcome for a bare token, the fixture and its expectation are updated deliberately, not left silently contradicting the new rule.

A `source_of_truth:` token that is unambiguously repository-root-relative by convention (if the AC-1 decision preserves any such case, e.g. a bare filename with no `../` matching a well-known root-level contract name) continues to resolve correctly -- the fix must not regress the one existing passing case.

No existing governed record anywhere in RepoPact's own repository, or in any adopter this work item can check, is silently reinterpreted as newly invalid by the resolution-rule change without being surfaced to an operator first.

Regression tests cover both a record-relative token with a `../` prefix and a bare token, and doctor's `--fix` behavior for `source-of-truth-stale` remains non-destructive (no auto-repair of an ambiguous or ostensibly-dead pointer without operator judgment) -- consistent with the existing docstring's own stated rationale.
